definitions.gloss: on hand; available; in one's possession
definitions.explanation: Items, money, or resources that one currently has and can use immediately. Often used as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ちの{現金|げんきん}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: I don't have enough cash on hand.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}で{何|なに}をしていいか{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I'm at a loose end and don't know what to do with myself.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ちの{株|かぶ}を{売|う}った。
examples.english: I sold the stocks I was holding.

notes:
COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
・{手|て} - hand
・{持|も}ち - holding, possession

KEY EXPRESSION:
・{手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた} - having nothing to do, at a loose end, idle
This expression describes the uncomfortable feeling of having nothing to do with one's hands/time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{手持|ても}ちの + [noun] - [noun] on hand, available [noun]
・{手持|ても}ちの{現金|げんきん} - cash on hand
・{手持|ても}ちの{資料|しりょう} - available materials
・{手持|ても}ちの{株|かぶ} - stock holdings

USAGE:
Often used as a no-adjective modifying another noun:
・{手持|ても}ち{品|ひん} - items in one's possession
・{手持|ても}ち{資金|しきん} - available funds
・{手持|ても}ちカメラ - handheld camera

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{在庫|ざいこ} - inventory, stock
・{所持|しょじ} - possession
・{保有|ほゆう} - holding, ownership
・{手元|てもと} - at hand, nearby

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation and business contexts.
